The independently registered Wirth report identifies that base language by title, author and distinct language scope. The parent target is the base Oberon language represented in the registry by Wirth's October 1990 language report. The lineage concerns the languages. It makes no claim of source or binary compatibility, exact edition equivalence, or a relationship to the operating system. The book’s [ReW92] points to a book about Oberon, while the registry identity is anchored in a 1990 report. The target is the language, with no assertion that the book referenced the 1990 PDF or that the two source editions are identical.
